caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows rich red, cradling tender chashu pork and crisp toppings. The bowl, adorned with floral patterns, sits on a silver tray against a warm orange backdrop, illuminated by soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Vibrant orange table surface, smooth and uniform, with subtle wood grain texture visible near top edge.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, light pink meat with a glistening, slightly caramelized surface and visible fat marbling.
The spicy broth is deep red, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible specks and steam rising.
White ceramic bowl with red rim and floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, circular shape with decorative border.
